summary: Verified all 5 security-hardening fixes AND core regressions. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass. In-browser CSV upload still works (frontend axios sends X-Requested-With: XobaMetrics globally). Public shared report renders without auth and leaks NO owner_id/profile_id. Admin login (admin@xobametrics.com / XobaAdmin2026!) still works — seed_admin no longer resets password. New report share_id is a 32-char hex. Second-user data isolation intact (new registered user sees empty releases).

issues: Pre-existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) mount warnings persist (cosmetic, noted in prior iterations).

security_checks_verified: New report share_id length == 32 (uuid4().hex, was 10 chars)
Admin login unchanged after seed_admin refactor
Frontend api.defaults.headers.common['X-Requested-With'] = 'XobaMetrics' — in-browser CSV upload succeeds end-to-end
Public /share/{sid} route in browser renders report with no auth and no leaked fields
Data isolation: newly-registered user gets empty /api/releases (does not see admin's data)
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py:263 storage.put_object exception is swallowed silently (path=None). Fine for functionality but a failed S3/MinIO write is invisible; consider logger.warning.

routes.py:259 the entire upload is read into memory before the 5MB check — a malicious client can still burn RAM by streaming a huge body. Consider enforcing Content-Length header check before file.read(), or use FastAPI's request body-size middleware.

server.py seed_admin now correctly no-ops password reset on existing admin, and no longer has a default password fallback — good. However seed_demo is called on every startup which reseeds demo data on admin (idempotent by design, but could be gated behind a flag).
get_shared_report whitelists fields via dict-comprehension — clean. Consider also stripping any owner_id from nested releases[] if analytics ever adds it (currently safe).
seed_data_creation: Test file creates TEST_ prefixed releases/reports and TEST_iso_ users; all cleaned up by test_zzz_cleanup and post-run mongo cleanup. Admin's Luna Eclipse workspace remains at pristine 3 releases (Take It Easy, Midnight Signal, Neon Rain). Note: pre-existing stale test user 'test_43c30a5f@example.com' from a previous iteration owns its own duplicate-named seeded releases; these are NOT visible to admin and do not affect admin demo state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_security_iter3.py is fully self-contained and reusable — covers CSRF header, file-size, row-cap, share-token entropy, shared-report field-whitelist, admin-login-persistence, and data-isolation. Uses X-Requested-With header explicitly. Cleans up TEST_ artifacts at end. Frontend axios client (lib/api.js) sets X-Requested-With globally so all in-browser flows are unaffected by the CSRF check.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or new bugs found.
